z-m-07-09.title: Zingaphi izonka ezimnandi zembotyi ebomvu ekufuneka ibhekari ibhake ngoMvulo olandelayo?
z-m-07-09.topic: Ukuqikelela oko kuphambili ngeerekhodi zentengiso (ukusingatha into engaqhelekanga)
z-m-07-09.goal: Yazi ukuba xa uqikelela oko kuphambili ngeerekhodi, indlela yokusingatha into engaqhelekanga ixhomekeke kwisizathu, uze ulungise uqikelelo lwakho nokuthemba kwakho ngolwazi olutsha, ubhale kwinqaku.
z-m-07-09.material: Ibhekari yommelwane ibhaka izonka ezimnandi zembotyi ebomvu zokuthengiswa ngolo suku njengamaxesha onke ekuseni. Ukuba ibhaka ezininzi kakhulu, ezinye ziyashiyeka, kwaye ukuba ibhaka ezimbalwa kakhulu, iyaphela. Umnini ufuna ukugqiba ukuba angabhaka ezingaphi zezonka ezimnandi zembotyi ebomvu ngoMvulo olandelayo ngokujonga iirekhodi zentengiso zeveki ephelileyo. Kwiveki ephelileyo ivenkile yavuliwe yonke imihla ukususela ngoMvulo ukuya ngolabuTano.

z-m-07-01.title: Ingaba imveliso yenani elinamanani amabini nenani elinedijithi enye isoloko inani elinamanani amathathu?
z-m-07-01.topic: Ukugqiba ukuba imveliso ye-(inani elinamanani amabini)×(inani elinedijithi enye) inamanani amangaphi
z-m-07-01.goal: Yazi ukuba imizekelo embalwa echanekileyo yokuphindaphinda ayenzi 'isoloko', yenza imizekelo yakho apho imveliso yenani elinamanani amabini nenani elinedijithi enye iyinani elinamanani amabini, uze uthi liba linani elinamanani amathathu nini.
z-m-07-01.material:
UDoyun wacombulula iingxaki zokuphindaphinda waza wathi oku.
'37×4=148, 52×6=312, 78×9=702. Imveliso yenani elinamanani amabini nenani elinedijithi enye isoloko inani elinamanani amathathu!'
(Apha inani elinamanani amabini linani elisuka ku-10 ukuya ku-99 kwaye inani elinedijithi enye linani elisuka ku-2 ukuya ku-9. 37×4 ifundwa 'amashumi amathathu anesixhenxe amaxesha amane'.)

z-m-07-01.thinking.2: Chaza umgangatho owahlula xa isebenza kwoko xa ingasebenzi

z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ecaleni komnye amanani uDoyun awavavanyileyo, 37, 52, no-78, namanani aphindaphinde ngawo, 4, 6, no-9, uze ufumane ukuba zeziphi iimeko angazivavanyanga.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Phindaphinda amanani amabini amancinci koluhlu namanani amabini amakhulu, uze uqikelele ukuba imveliso ikuluhlu olunjani.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.a: Uphindaphinde ngenani elinedijithi enye, ngoko imveliso isoloko inani elinamanani amabini
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.a: Inani elinamanani amabini elibe sisiphindaphindi esinedijithi enye alenzi imveliso ibe linani elinamanani amabini. Jonga ukuba imveliso ye-78×9, uDoyun ayinikileyo, inamanani amangaphi.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.b: Ukuba inani elinedijithi enye li-9, imveliso isoloko inani elinamanani amathathu
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.b: Nokuphindaphinda nge-9 kunokunika inani elinamanani amabini. Jonga ukuba imveliso ye-10×9 iyintoni.

z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.c: Umzekelo ukuchaneka kwahlukile ekubeni "soloko" echanekile. Kufuneka ujonge ukuba zikho iimeko ezingekavavanywa.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.o.d: Ngamanye amaxesha linani elinamanani amathathu kwaye ngamanye linamanani amabini
z-m-07-01.s.s1.r.d: Le yingcinga yokuba inani lamanani emveliso linokutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kubukhulu bamanani amabini aphindaphindwayo. Iba lucacile ngakumbi ukuba wenza imizekelo uze uhlole.
z-m-07-01.s.s1.explain: Eyona mveliso incinci koluhlu yi-10×2=20 kwaye eyona mveliso inkulu yi-99×9=891. Ngoko imveliso inokuba linani elinamanani amabini okanye amathathu, kwaye ayinakuba linani elinamanani amane.

z-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha amanani amancinci kuqala uphindaphinde, uze uhlole ukuba imveliso inamanani amangaphi.

z-m-07-06.title: Ukuba unamathelisa oonxantathu ababini abanamakona angqukuva abafanayo, ngaba ufumana inxande ngalo lonke ixesha?
z-m-07-06.topic: Imilo eyenziwe ngokunamathelisa oonxantathu ababini abanamakona angqukuva abafanayo (imo nomjikelezo)
z-m-07-06.goal: Vavanya isibango se-'ngalo lonke ixesha' ngokutshintsha imiphetho neendlela zokunamathelisa ukufumana umzekelo ochasayo, uze uchaze ukuba umjikelezo utshintsha njani njengoko umphetho onamathelisiweyo ufihliwe.
z-m-07-06.material:
Kukho iishiti ezimbini zephepha elinemibala emilo yoonxantathu abanamakona angqukuva. Ezi zimbini zinobukhulu nemo efanayo kanye. Imiphetho emibini ecaleni kwekona engqukuva inobude be-3 cm ne-4 cm, kwaye owona mphetho mde yi-5 cm. Namathelisa ezi zimbini kunye ecaleni kwemiphetho enobude obulinganayo, kanye, ngaphandle kwesithuba okanye ukugqithisana, wenze imilo entsha. Unokujija okanye ujikise iphepha phambi kokunamathelisa.
U-Seoa wathi, 'Ukuba unamathelisa oonxantathu ababini abanamakona angqukuva abafanayo, ihlala iyinxande!'
(3 cm ifundwa 'iisentimitha ezintathu'.)
z-m-07-06.thinking.0: Hlula xa isibango sisebenza kunye nexa singasebenzi
z-m-07-06.thinking.1: Fumana imizekelo echasayo ngokutshintsha umphetho onamathelisiweyo
z-m-07-06.thinking.2: Chaza ukuba umphetho onamathelisiweyo uchaphazela njani umjikelezo

z-m-07-06.prereq.1: Umjikelezo wemilo bubude bomjikelo wawo wonke emphethweni wayo
z-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yenza oonxantathu ababini abanamakona angqukuva (3 cm, 4 cm, 5 cm) ngephepha uzobe imilo oyifumanayo njengoko utshintsha umphetho onamathelisiweyo. Ukuba akunaphepha, cinga ikona engqukuva njengekona yencwadi uyenze engqondweni.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwimilo enamathelisiweyo, jonga ukuba onke amakona amane ayiingile engqukuva na nokuba inemiphetho emine na.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Esi sisigqibo sokuba uya kujonga ngokutshintsha umphetho onamathelisiweyo nesalathiso ozibeka ngaso. Kuya kucaca ngakumbi ukuba ufumana ukuba kwiimeko ezithini iba yinxande.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Uyazi iingile ezingqukuva nobude bemiphetho, ngoko ungasebenza engqondweni nakuba ungekanamathelisi iphepha. Khumbula ukuba onke amakona amane enxande ayiingile engqukuva na.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Nokuba uzinamathelisa njani, ayiyi kuba yinxande
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Ingaba ujonge ukuba ayikho ngokwenene indlela yokunamathelisa eyenza inxande? Jonga kwakhona imeko yokunamathelisa imiphetho emide kakhulu.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Esi sisigqibo esilandele isibango sika-Seoa njengoko sinjalo. Yenza uze ujonge nemeko yokunamathelisa imiphetho ye-3 cm wena.
z-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuba unamathelisa imiphetho ye-5 cm, ujikisa icandelo elinye, iba yinxande engu-3 cm ububanzi kwaye engu-4 cm ukuphakama. Ukuba unamathelisa imiphetho ye-3 cm, ukujija icandelo elinye kunika unxantathu omkhulu kwaye ukujikisa icandelo elinye kunika imilo ethe tyabi enamacala amane, ngoko ayiyiyo inxande. Ngoko kuxhomekeke kumphetho onamathelisiweyo nendlela.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Masifumane umjikelezo wemilo enamathelisiweyo. Isixa sobude bemiphetho yonke emithathu kunxantathu omnye onengile engqukuva yi-12 cm. Xa unamathelisa imiphetho enobude obulinganayo, vumela ubude bomphetho onamathelisiweyo bube yi-j cm (enye kwezi-3, 4, 5), ufumane iimeko ezimbini ezahlukileyo apho umjikelezo wemilo oyenzayo mde kune-14 cm.

z-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Umjikelezo awude kune-14 cm. Jonga ukuba kukho umphetho ofihliwe xa unamathelisiweyo.
z-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Umjikelezo wecandelo elinye yi-3+4+5=12 cm, ngoko amacandelo amabini enza i-24 cm. Umphetho onamathelisiweyo ungena ngaphakathi kwaye ufihlwa kumacandelo omabini. Ukunamathelisa umphetho we-3 cm kunika i-24−6=18 cm, umphetho we-4 cm unika i-24−8=16 cm, kwaye umphetho we-5 cm unika i-24−10=14 cm. Umjikelezo ude kune-14 cm uvela ekunamathelisweni komphetho we-3 cm okanye we-4 cm.

z-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ubhale uyazi ukuba umzekelo omnye ochasayo uyanela ukuphula 'ngalo lonke ixesha'?

z-m-07-10.goal: Yazi ukuba awukwazi ukugqiba ukuba iingxowa ezimbini ziyahluka ngeziphumo ezimbalwa zezoba ezili-10, uze uthi iziphumo zisebenza njengezalathiso kangakanani nendlela yokuhlola ngakumbi.
z-m-07-10.material:
Kukho iingxowa ezimbini ezineegoli ezibomvu neziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zixutyiwe (Ingxowa 가, Ingxowa 나). Asazi ukuba zingaphi iigoli kwingxowa nganye okanye ukuba iingxowa ezimbini ziyafana okanye ziyahluka. USeoha wathatha igoli elinye kwiNgxowa 가 kwaye uHaram wathatha elinye kwiNgxowa 나, bajonga umbala wawo bawubuyisela, benza oku amaxesha ali-10 ngamnye.
Ingxowa 가 (USeoha): obomvu amaxesha ama-7, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka amaxesha ama-3
Ingxowa 나 (UHaram): obomvu amaxesha ama-4, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka amaxesha ama-6
USeoha wathi, 'Ingxowa yam inobomvu obuninzi nengxowa kaHaram inobuhlaza okwesibhakabhaka obuninzi. Iingxowa ezimbini ziyahluka!'
